definitions.late_close: 4th quarter with the margin before the kick within 8, or overtime (play_filters.is_late_and_close_state; the clutch-kick rule). Never garbage time.
definitions.inside_5: a punt that ends at or inside the receiving team's 5, not a touchback, not blocked (the same end spot as inside_20 / inside_10 in special_teams_season).
definitions.backed_up_punts: punts snapped at or inside the punting team's own 10 (situations.BACKED_UP_YL_ABS, the drive engine's backed-up zone); net average and blocks.
definitions.returns_to_midfield: punt returns that end at or past midfield (the return team's frame).
definitions.returns_past_own_40: kickoff returns that end at or past the return team's own 40.
definitions.tie_or_lead: 4th-quarter or overtime field goals with the kicking team down 0-3 before the kick: a make ties or takes the lead. `against` / `stopped` are the same kicks faced.
definitions.two_point: live two-point tries (special_teams.two_point_tries). mandatory = overtime from the second round on. stops = tries against that failed.
definitions.special_teams_epa: sum of the stream EPA of every late-and-close kick, in this team's frame (kicking or returning), from st_events.
definitions.margin_source: the kick row's own score margin and garbage-time verdict (kick rows are scored from the kicking team's side, enrichment score_perspective_team_id).
definitions.scope: games between two of the 18 with play-by-play. `competitive` drops garbage-time kicks (play_filters.is_garbage_time); late-and-close fields are identical in both.
